experiment: #4 FPR of Logarithmic-phase trigger on benign traffic, real data W=10
trigger_rule: epsilon_p > gamma -> Logarithmic phase (aggressive rotation clamp at delta_theta_max)
interpretation: gamma=1.984 sits at benign-only P75 (1.9814), NOT P95 (2.3061). It was recalibrated against the gate's FILTERED benign pool, not the raw sequential benign windows. Consequence: benign-only Logarithmic-phase FPR at the operating gamma is ~25% (1 in 4 benign samples flips into the aggressive rotation regime) -- elevated and above the intended ~5%. If gamma were set to benign-only P95 (2.3061), FPR would be 5.0% by construction. Recommend re-examining gamma calibration or reporting FPR at a P95-based gamma.
